name: audio-calibration
description: Cross-platform guided and expert REW measurement, human-listening assessment, and guarded calibration for general speaker systems, cars, and computers

interface.shortDescription: Human-focused REW calibration with expert controls.
interface.longDescription: Runs guided or expert REW sessions, rejects unreliable measurements, analyzes listening-relevant dimensions without a fake global score, designs cut-only EQ against held-out traces, exports cross-platform filters, guides level-matched listening tests, and manages optional JamesDSP presets with backup and rollback.
defaultPrompt: Analyze my room or car audio response with expert evidence and uncertainty.
Create and validate a reversible cross-platform EQ preset.
Run a guided human-listening calibration for my laptop speakers.
